description: ODC: the REFUSAL of the delete of a SCREEN. WfCovTaskDetail comes from the chain screen-form -> screen-list and has two real consumers: the OnClick of the TaskItem of the list WfCovTasks and the OnClick of the button NewButton. Without force the delete has to be refused AND the message has to name both. The module itself also cites it (in ODC the ESpace has DefaultScreen and the first screen created headless got that role), but that no longer refuses: the Studio deletes the default screen and leaves only the warning 'Unknown Default Screen' (coverage tested, phase 2). Runs in OdcJobTests.JobFailsWithTheTeachingMessageInTheOdcLane. The clean path is in tests/jobs-odc/delete-screen.json.
expectError: list them with usages, fix or remove those usages, or pass "force": true to break them
